sector_notes: The market backdrop is constructive but event-driven: Tuesday's session added 0.6% for the S&P 500 and 1.2% for the Nasdaq, while Wednesday futures are mixed ahead of the Fed decision and major technology earnings. Technology and semiconductors remain the leadership area, supported by strong AI-demand signals, but elevated oil prices and inflation concerns increase rate sensitivity. Healthcare, financials and selected industrials provide useful diversification while the Fed and earnings can rapidly change risk appetite.
